where_it_happens: Kitchen during busy meals when chips, fried items, tacos and quesadillas fire together
why_it_matters: Two stations peak at once and a short pass cannot plate both while fried items stay crisp
what_a_future_test_measures: Order-to-plate time and chip crispness when fryer and comal tickets overlap

where_it_happens: Bar when beer pours and garnished NA drinks are ordered together
why_it_matters: Cut citrus and herb garnish adds bar steps and can make the NA drink slower than beer
what_a_future_test_measures: Pour-and-garnish time for NA versus beer when queued together

where_it_happens: Table service when guests ask for pairings
why_it_matters: Explaining pairings takes server time that competes with turning tables and with attention to other guests
what_a_future_test_measures: Server minutes per pairing conversation and whether it delays seating or service

where_it_happens: Glass wash and bar when many glass shapes are in use
why_it_matters: More shapes increase wash handling, breakage and shortage risk, and NA glassware needs equal care
what_a_future_test_measures: Glass turn time and shortages with different shape counts

where_it_happens: Cold room and walk-in during braise cooling and raw goat storage
why_it_matters: Cooling a large braise can displace other stock, and raw goat must stay separate from ready food
what_a_future_test_measures: Cooling time and cold-space use of a braise beside normal stock

where_it_happens: Entrance and dining where children and alcohol production or service share sightlines
why_it_matters: Families need a comfortable table while alcohol service stays apart as rules require
what_a_future_test_measures: Family routes against bar and brewhouse sightlines; an attorney sets the rules

where_it_happens: Prep stations and fryer where chicken and goat are near paneer and gobi
why_it_matters: Vegetarian guests expect separation and allergens must not cross
what_a_future_test_measures: Cross-contact risk points in station layout and shared fryer oil

collision: Shared comal across tortilla warming, quesadilla and goat tacos
why_it_matters: One heat surface is the assumed bottleneck for three Core 5 dishes
what_a_future_test_measures: Comal minutes per plate and queue length with mixed orders

collision: Dipped goat tacos with consomme service
where_it_happens: Pass and table for the goat dish
why_it_matters: Hot consomme cups add plating steps and a spill and burn risk for tables with children
what_a_future_test_measures: Plate time, spill points and temperature on arrival

collision: Dairy cold chain for a lassi-style NA drink
where_it_happens: Walk-in and bar for cultured dairy used in the quesadilla pairing
why_it_matters: Cold shelf competes with kitchen dairy and the drink shortens the pairing list if it fails
what_a_future_test_measures: Cold shelf space and shelf-life limits of the drink

collision: Dish pit load of pots, plates and glasses
where_it_happens: Dish area after braise, sauce and service
why_it_matters: Pots and glasses compete for one wash path and wash time
what_a_future_test_measures: Wash cycle time when braise pots and glasses arrive together

where_it_happens: Kitchen at close with braise, makhani and marinades
why_it_matters: Cooling and labelling compete with cleaning and prep for the next day
what_a_future_test_measures: Cooldown and labelling time at close

why_it_matters: Chips lose crunch during a long carry, and patio guests are easy to forget
what_a_future_test_measures: Crispness after the patio carry and patio plate delay
